text: Long catch-up with Divya. She's flying to Chennai on May 14 for her cousin's wedding, then on to Singapore for a week. Her husband Isaac can't get the time off so he's staying home with the dog. Text her the night before she flies. She also mentioned her mum has been unwell and might need a scan when she's back, so she's a bit torn about going at all. Ask how the wedding went once she's home, sometime around the end of May.
Ibrahim rang. His mum's knee op is finally booked for June 3rd at 8am. He sounded wiped out. I said I'd drop round with food sometime that week.

Coffee w Marisol and Leon. They're doing Japan in the spring, three weeks, Tokyo then Kyoto. Leon is dreading the 14 hour flight. Marisol wants recs for ryokans, send her the list from Hiroshi. They're also thinking of a day in Osaka for the food. Leon's birthday falls while they're away, April 18, so maybe slip a card in her bag before they go.
Saanvi's leaving drinks moved to Thursday at 6. Apparently she starts at the new firm 5/12.
Catch up w Antoine. Lisbon trip is off, his sister had the baby early so he's going to Lyon instead to meet his niece. Back sometime after the 20th. Should send something for the baby.

Bao called about the cabin weekend. We're thinking sometime next month, not before the 15th. Ava might bring her new boyfriend Rhys. I'm doing the drive, Bao's sorting the food. Ava's coeliac so we need to plan around that. Rhys apparently plays guitar, Bao reckons we'll get a campfire singalong whether we like it or not. Need to confirm dates with everyone by Sunday evening.
Afua said her dad retires at the end of June after 32 years at the hospital. Big party planned, June 28th at 7pm. She's terrified about giving a speech.
Must post Lena's birthday card by Wednesday morning.
Seo-yeon is back from Seoul. Jet lag is wrecking her, she said she slept till 2pm yesterday. Her grandmother is doing better than they feared. Check in with her end of the week.
Hiroshi and his wife Noor are renewing their passports, planning NZ for Christmas. He collects old maps, wants anything from Wellington apparently. Gift idea.
Quick one: Ioana's flight lands 7/9 at 11:40pm, I'm picking her up from arrivals.

Ilse mentioned her brother Eamon is moving to Toronto in the autumn for work. She's gutted, they've always lived ten minutes apart. Their parents don't know yet. Maybe take her out for dinner soon, she seemed low.
Anya's interview with the airline is Tuesday at 10. She really wants it, cabin crew has been the dream since forever. Wish her luck Monday night!!
Rhys hates flying. Takes the train everywhere, even did Paris to Rome by rail last summer.

Chen and Zoe are getting married in Bali, date is March 22 next year. They want to know who's actually coming by Christmas. Need to look at flights before prices go mad. Chen said there's a welcome dinner the night before, March 21 at 7pm on the beach, and a recovery brunch on the 23rd. Zoe's sister Joanna is maid of honour and already panicking about the speech.
Joanna's son Oliver got into Edinburgh! Starting in September. She's thrilled but already worried about him being so far. Send her a congrats message tonight.
Saw Camila at the school gate this morning. Her mum's visiting from Bogotá for six weeks, arriving the 2nd. Camila's planning a big dinner for her on the Saturday, I'm invited.
Nina mentioned she's been struggling since the breakup, not sleeping much. Says work is the only thing keeping her going. Call her at the weekend, properly, not just a text.
Yetunde is off to Lagos for her nephew's naming ceremony, August 3rd. Flying out the 30th at 9pm, back the following Sunday. She asked if I could water her plants and feed her cat Pepper.

Haruto finished his Iron Man in Copenhagen last Sunday! 13 hours something. Ask him for the photos. He said his knee held up until the marathon section, then it was pure grit. His wife Seo-yeon and their two kids were at the finish line with a huge banner. He's already talking about Kona, she's already talking about divorce. Book a celebratory dinner for the four of us sometime next month.

Hassan and Sara are thinking of moving to Dubai after Christmas. Nothing confirmed, he's waiting on the contract. Sara's not convinced, she'd have to leave her clinic. Ask him next month if the offer came through. Their eldest, Isaac, is in his last year of primary so timing matters. Hassan said they'd fly out in January to look at schools and flats, probably the week of the 12th.
Need to renew the car insurance before Friday at noon, and book the MOT sometime soon.
Michael called from the airport. His connection in Doha got cancelled, now stuck till tomorrow morning. Said he'd ring when he lands. He's got the presentation on the 18th at 2pm so fingers crossed.
Divya Gupta, or Div as everyone calls her, is hosting the reunion this year. Saturday Nov 14 from 4pm, her place. Bring the photo albums.
Isaac's dad had a fall on Sunday night. Broken wrist, in plaster six weeks. Isaac's going up to see him this weekend. Ask how his dad's doing next week.
Ava said she's dropping hints for her birthday, wants one of those fancy travel pillows for long-haul. Birthday is Oct 30.
Antoine Bianchi, my old flatmate, is in town Friday at 5pm only. Meet him at the station for a drink before his train.
Ibrahim's daughter Lena has her first piano recital on the 12th at half 9 in the morning. He asked if I'd come. She's nervous, he says she's been practicing every night.

Marisol's back from Mexico City. Loved it, ate everything. Her brother Leon proposed to his girlfriend on the trip, at the top of the pyramid. She's planning the engagement party for sometime in the new year.
Bao's grandmother passed away on Tuesday. Funeral is next Friday at 11. He's flying back to Hanoi tomorrow evening. Send flowers to his mum and message him tonight.
Got chatting to Noor after yoga. She teaches year 3 at St Anne's. Vegan, allergic to nuts. Has a rescue greyhound called Biscuit.
Michael and his partner Sara Lewis celebrated ten years together on the 4th, went to Venice for the weekend. Belated card maybe.
Hiroshi's flight back from Osaka is June 21st at 6:15am, I'm taking him to brunch the day after.
Seo-yeon's driving test got moved to April 9 at 3:30pm. She's failed twice already and is really anxious about it. Don't forget to text her the morning of.

Rhys just told me he's doing a semester in Melbourne from February. Flight is something like 22 hours. His mum is not happy about it. He'll be back in July, maybe. Should do a send-off thing before he goes, sometime in January. He's been learning to surf at Croyde to prepare, which is hilarious given he can barely swim. Girlfriend Anya is staying here, they're going to try long distance.
Zoe's planning a girls' trip to Croatia in the summer. Me, her, Afua and maybe Camila. Needs deposits by the end of the month.
Ilse's birthday dinner Saturday at 8, the Italian place. Get her that book on Iceland, she keeps talking about going.
Chen called to say the Bali wedding venue fell through, they're looking at Lombok instead. Same date though. Zoe's stressed about redoing all the invites.

Didn't get to talk much with Eamon but he's clearly not okay. His dad's been in hospital since the weekend, heart thing. Eamon flew back from Boston on Monday night. I should drop him a message tomorrow morning to see how his dad is.
Joanna's visiting her sister in Vancouver for Thanksgiving, flying out Oct 8. Asked me to keep an eye on the house. Back 10/15.
Booked my own flights for Lisbon, leaving Sept 6 at 7am. Still need to sort a hotel.
Afua's speech went fine! Her dad cried. She said the party went until 2am. Ask her for the video when she's caught up on sleep.
Leon got the job with the airline, starts in ground ops on August 1st. Marisol says he's over the moon, they'll finally get cheap flights. Congrats text to Leon.

Divya called about Isaac's 40th. Surprise party on March 7 at 7:30 at the rugby club, she's flying his brother Michael in from Dubai. Don't tell Isaac obviously. I'm on cake duty. Need to transfer her £30 for the present by Friday.

Nice long chat with Camila. Her daughter starts nursery in January, she's anxious about going back to work full time after. Her husband Antoine has been doing nights so she's knackered. Pop round with lunch next week sometime. Also her mum's flying in from Bogotá on Dec 18 at 6am and staying through January, which should help. Camila's mum makes amazing tamales, apparently, I've been invited for Christmas Eve.
Hassan said his cousin Nina had a little boy on Sunday morning, 7lb 2oz. Both doing well. Must organise a card from the team and maybe a group gift.
Anya didn't get the cabin crew job. She's ok, says she'll reapply in the spring. Checking in with her soon.
Haruto mentioned his partner Ilse is starting a PhD in Utrecht next autumn. They're going long distance for a bit. He's going to visit every few weeks, cheap flights from Stansted.
Ioana loves tea, especially those smoky Lapsang ones. Hates coffee. Note for Christmas.
Saanvi wants to do a call with Nina and me sometime soon, she's got news. Suspect it's the engagement. Set up the call for Sunday at 4.
Michael's sister is having twins! Due early December. He's going to be an uncle twice over, totally beside himself.
Hiroshi and Noor's trip got cancelled, Noor's mum fell ill. They're staying put for Christmas. Hiroshi was really looking forward to it.
Remember: Oliver's flight to Edinburgh is 9/2 at 6:50am. Joanna asked if I can give them both a lift to the airport at 4.

Dinner with Sara, Hassan and their kids. They're off to Morocco at Easter, then her parents come to stay in May. Sara's dad is turning 70 on May 19, big family do. Hassan's training for a half marathon in Marrakech too. Their youngest has just started swimming lessons, Saturdays at 9am, and absolutely loves it. Sara asked if I'd help with the surprise slideshow for her dad. Need to dig out old photos from the Wales holiday and send them to her before May 1st.
Cancelled dentist on Thursday, rebook for after the holidays.
Eamon's dad is home from hospital. Recovering well. Eamon's heading back to Boston on the 28th at 5pm. Grab a coffee with him before then.
Lena said her uncle Oliver runs a little bakery in Bristol, sourdough's apparently unreal. She's going down there in the spring. Ask her to bring me a loaf back haha.
Bao's back from Hanoi. Quiet but ok, said the funeral was beautiful. His mum is staying with him for a month. Invite them both for dinner sometime after the 10th.

Zoe Kowalski aka Zo just got back from Patagonia. Three weeks hiking, says the 26 hour journey home nearly killed her. She's doing a slideshow evening Friday the 23rd at 7, I said I'd bring wine. Her partner Haruto didn't go, he's saving his leave for their trip to Japan in the spring to see his parents. Zo's already planning Iceland for next winter. Ask her for the name of that tour company, Ilse might want it.
Yetunde's maternity leave started yesterday. Baby's due Nov 2. She's bored already, wants visitors. Go see her Saturday afternoon.
